The '''Kuna's Eye system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Zuma sector/Legends|Zuma sector]], within the [[Inner Zuma Region]] and the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell subsector]]. It was less than 1,000 [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] above the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic plane]]&mdash;a trait that made it a part of the thick disk, which spanned 1,000 light-[[Standard year/Legends|years]] vertically on both sides of the plane. The system contained the young [[Blue giant/Legends|blue giant]] [[Kuna's Eye/Legends|Kuna's Eye]] and a [[Unidentified protoplanetary disk|protoplanetary disk]], which was rich in [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]], metals, and alloys. As of [[43 ABY]], prospectors frequented the system, with a cobbled-together [[Space station/Legends|space station]] and [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]], the [[Mote]], serving their needs.

==Description==
The Kuna's Eye [[Star system/Legends|system]] was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="teaoc" /> west of the region known as the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] and southeast of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. The system was located within the [[Inner Zuma Region]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Zuma sector/Legends|Zuma sector]],<ref name="teaoc" /> inside the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell subsector]]. Its distance from the horizontal [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic plane]] was less than 1,000 [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]], which placed it within the [[thin disk]], a tract of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] whose vertical distance from the plane was no more than 1,000 light-[[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="TEA" />

The system's primary [[Star/Legends|star]] was [[Kuna's Eye/Legends|Kuna's Eye]], a [[Blue giant/Legends|blue giant]] that, along with the other Kuna [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], formed part of the [[Kuna constellation]] visible from the planet [[Maya Kovel/Legends|Maya Kovel]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
Members of two [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Tulgah/Legends|Tulgah]] and the [[Jinda/Legends|Jindas]], attempted to colonize the system from<ref name="CoE">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/feature20081201.html|text=Castaways of Endor|int=Castaways of Endor}}</ref> the [[Factory world/Legends|factory world]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] circa [[130 BBY]], but their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Free Enterprise]]'', crashed on the [[Tree/Legends|forested]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] instead.<ref name="CoE" />

The sun of the system, Kuna's Eye, was considered to be young as of [[43 ABY]]<ref name="TEA" /> and was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by a [[Unidentified protoplanetary disk|protoplanetary disk]] of dust and rock<ref name="gamer9" /> that was rich in [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]],<ref name="TEA" /> metals, and alloys. At the edge of the disk was the [[Mote]], a cobbled-together [[Space station/Legends|space station]]<ref name="gamer9" /> and [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] dedicated to fulfilling the needs of the prospectors that were attracted to the system.<ref name="TEA" /> The station hosted 1,000 individuals of various species.<ref name="gamer9" />

==Behind the scenes==
The first mention of the Kuna's Eye system was in the article "[[Endor and the Moddell Sector]]"&mdash;written by [[Craig Robert Carey]], [[Daniel Wallace]], and [[Jason Fry]]&mdash;in [[Star Wars Gamer 9|''Star Wars Gamer'' 9]],<ref name="gamer9" /> released on [[February 22]], [[2002]].<ref name="GamerDate">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20020222.html|text=Starfighters Soar in Gamer #9}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system in grid square H-16.<ref name="TEA" />
